correctness.rationale: For each primitive idempotent the multiplication map has image the trace-orthogonal plane to its complement. value.rationale: The finite-field \(H_2\) case is the first symmetric Jordan algebra where idempotent words exhibit exceptional behavior. This theorem determines the complete incidence of possible last primitive factors, including a split versus nonsplit field dichotomy, and proves that explicitly many nonscalar matrices cannot be idempotent words; these forbidden counts grow cubically and exclude roughly half the ambient space. This is a natural structural invariant and boundary for future full word-length classifications, rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
